result.one_liner: Jira is a project management and issue tracking platform for planning, tracking, and managing work across teams.

evidence.quote: OAuth 2.0 Authentication for Jira REST API involves the use of OAuth protocol to obtain the access or Id token
For API Token (Basic Auth): Generate a token at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens
Jira Cloud has a comprehensive self-serve REST API (v3) on every tier including Free
free plan provides access to the full functionality of the Jira REST API
The Jira Cloud platform REST API
users can generate API tokens directly without requiring administrative approval

result.notes: Jira Cloud offers full API access on the free tier with self-serve credential generation. OAuth 2.0 is the modern standard; OAuth 1.0a and API tokens with basic auth are also supported. Forge apps use JWT. The REST API is comprehensive with endpoints covering projects, issues, workflows, users, and more.
